title: Women's 400m World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The leading eleven athletes in World Athletics' women's 400m (300m–500m) event ranking as of 3 November 2026, including both athletes with the tenth-highest ranking score. Values are ranking points, not race times; associated 300m–500m and short-track performances can contribute. Equal points appear as ties here, while the source lists sequential places. This dated snapshot is partial and the live source may change.
